name: vaultwarden
description: Unofficial Bitwarden compatible server written in Rust, formerly known as bitwarden_rs
one_liner: A lightweight, self-hosted server that works with the official Bitwarden password-manager apps, so a business can run its own private password vault instead of paying per-user fees to Bitwarden's cloud.
buyer: A managed IT service provider (MSP) that wants to offer clients secure password management without per-seat Bitwarden licensing costs.
business_use_cases: An MSP hosts and manages Vaultwarden instances for a dozen small-business clients as part of a security bundle.
A startup self-hosts it for its own team instead of paying for Bitwarden's business tier, then later offers the setup as a service to others.
A freelance sysadmin offers a one-time 'set up your own private password manager' installation service to small businesses.

money_ideas.idea: Run a hosted-and-managed Vaultwarden service billed per user per month, undercutting official Bitwarden business pricing.
Offer a one-time setup, migration, and hardening service for businesses that want to self-host it themselves.

steal_this: Spin up managed Vaultwarden instances on a few cheap VPS boxes this weekend and sell them to small teams at $2-3/user/month — half of Bitwarden's business price.
